The '''dancers' quarters''' were a set of apartments in the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild headquarters]] located in the [[Old Galactic Market]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Ria Deleru]] became a dancer here when she escaped her mate, [[Nik Deleru]].
